recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7351 unless the work group separately decides to revise the broader clinical overview context list.
issue_request: FHIR-7351 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core overview change request from the 2015May cycle asking section 1.7.2 to add "ambulatory care" to the list of contexts where FHIR is intended to be usable. The approved resolution was "add it".
initial_application: The Jira comment says "svn review 6511". Git history contains commit 5e324fa4ca06ecbd4ad29e342be1dda60a0d8b1c, imported from SVN build@6511, with subject "#7351, #7352, #7445, #7353 - editorial updates to clinical overview". That commit inserted "ambulatory care" into source/overview-clinical.html.
additional_context: source/overview-clinical.html remains an active clinical overview page: source/hierarchy.xml lists overview-clinical.html as "Clinical Introduction", publish.ini has an output entry for overview-clinical.html, and multiple current pages link to it. Current wording has evolved editorially to say "usable" and also includes "acute care", but it still preserves the requested ambulatory-care context. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence. Same-family issues FHIR-7352, FHIR-7353, and FHIR-7445 were implemented in the same historical commit and already have separate combined-branch audit commits.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already satisfies FHIR-7351 in substance.
